handoff_assertion: The D1P-C03 task handoff states that the design changes were approved by two planners.

design_items.description: Widen scope to proof-consuming ZK systems and traverse source indexes with seed and supplemental keyword routes.
Reserve half of newly eligible unexposed provisional family groups by a private human draw and store only a salted commitment plus attestation.
Use typed AI-planner design reviews and limit human sign-off to staffing, reservation, and annotation rounds.
Separate design_frozen, reservation_completed, and annotation_round_completed schema states.
Pilot 20 development packets as four unscored calibration packets and 16 fresh independent packets.
Keep human disclosure assessment separate from the artifacts-to-validation tool funnel.
